g.text: Tokens to dollars: a Sydney team of 1,000
Claude Sonnet 4.5 on the au. profile: $3.30 per million input tokens, $16.50 per million output tokens
50,000 requests over an 8-hour day ≈ 104 per minute
plan 2–3× for peaks, and keep max_tokens tight
Every number here is an assumption you can swap. The method stays the same: tokens × price for the bill, (input + 5 × output) per minute for the quota.
